pvObligation.name: PV obligation in existing buildings
pvObligation.description: Assists in determining the roof area that must be covered with PV when significant roof renovations are carried out.
pvObligation.roofsAreLoadingSpinner: Please be patient, the roofs are currently been loaded ...
pvObligation.generateReportSpinner: The report is currently been generated ...

wizard.introduction: This application is intended to assist in calculating the area that must be covered with photovoltaics when “significant roof modifications” are carried out. The PDF report is for your personal records and serves as proof in the event of a random check. You can find more information on the PV obligation here:
wizard.introductionPart2: None of the information provided below is stored on servers. The PDF is created locally on your computer. Data is handled in accordance with the DSGVO.

component.introduction: Click on the desired building in the map to determine the gross roof area.
component.hintSearch: (Tip: Use the search to find and display the building more quickly.)
component.grossAreaDescription: The gross roof area includes the entire roof area of the building, including all sub-areas regardless of orientation, use, or shading. If this area exceeds 50 m², it is subject to the PV obligation if ‘significant roof modifications’ are carried out.
component.grossAreaText: The gross roof area of the selected building is:
component.grossAreaHint: (Note: The roof areas have been recorded automatically. There may be deviations from the actual area. Please take this into account in the next step or under ‘Personal notes’.)
component.tooSmallAreaText: There is no PV obligation (minimum size 50 m²).

confirmModal.contentIntro: You have already selected a roof area. If you change the roof area, all previously entered data will be lost.
confirmModal.contentQuestion: Do you really want to change the roof area?

component.missingStepGrossAreaError: Please first select your roof in the step "Gross roof area".
component.missingStepGrossAreaMessage: Afterwards, the initial net roof area will be displayed here, and you can, if necessary, draw areas that should additionally be excluded.
component.drawingIsNotCompletedError: The drawing is not yet complete. Please select Save or Cancel before proceeding to the next step.
component.introduction: The net roof area is the gross roof area minus roof structures, skylights, other necessary roof uses and the north-facing portion of the roof with a slope of over 10 degrees. At least 30% of this must be covered with PV. We have automatically determined a net roof area for your building, taking into account roof areas facing “north” with an inclination of more than 10 degrees.
component.netRoofAreaText: The selected net roof area is: {{ displayNetRoofArea }} m²
component.obligatedAreaText: Minimum area for PV is:{{ obligatedArea }} m² (30% of the net roof area).
component.additionalNetAreaText: Here you have the option of adding additional areas that are relevant for calculating the net roof area. These are taken into account in the above-mentioned areas.
component.netAreaNoteText: (Note: Shading and other technical impossibilities must only be taken into account in the next step)
component.disabledMessage: The drawing in net restricted area is not yet finished

component.missingStepGrossAreaError: Please first select your roof in the step "Gross roof area".
component.missingStepGrossAreaMessage: Afterwards, you can, if necessary, draw areas here that you want to designate as restricted areas.
component.introduction: At least 30% of the net roof area must be covered with PV. This is the duty. This obligation may not apply if other public law regulations or technical impossibilities conflict with this. If there are several of these areas, it is possible that (justifiably) less than 30% of the net roof area can be occupied.
component.additionalInfo: Here you have the option of specifying areas where the obligation does not apply. Reasons can be: incompatibility with monument protection, requirements from the HBauO (distance areas), areas that are more than slightly shaded, but also technical impossibilities.
component.disabledMessage: The drawing in net roof area is not yet finished

component.introduction: Please enter the name of the owner here.
Here you have the option to add your own explanations about the areas that you consider relevant.
Below you can generate a PDF report containing the information you provided. You can keep this as proof for your records.
component.generalError: Error: Not all required fields are filled in. Please complete the missing information to generate the report.

restrictionList.formHeaderCreateDescription: Use the drawing tool below to mark a relevant area on your roof and add a note. After saving, you can record more areas or edit them in the list.
restrictionList.numberExplaination: The identifier ({{ id }}) corresponds to the area marked on the map with the same ID.

helpFormDraw.text: To add a new relevant area, draw it directly on your roof area in the map. When drawing a polygon, place the desired corner points one after another and finish the input with a double click.

helpFormDrawModify.text: You can modify the drawings you created directly on the map using the mouse.

restrictionList.missingAreaText: Please draw the area to be excluded from the net roof area.
